scripts.dev: node scripts/kill-prev.js && concurrently --kill-others -n server,client "pnpm --filter @repo/server dev" "pnpm --filter @repo/client dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @repo/shared build && pnpm --filter @repo/server build && pnpm --filter @repo/client build
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/game-ui/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/client/tsconfig.json
